strings.en: I shall personally send you to your grave!
Die!
Uoooh!!
I'll squash you like a bug!
You won't leave alive!
I am the Great General of Darkness, master of Mykene's seven legions!
Behold the power of the Great General of Darkness!!
Face my strike!!
Are you ready for hell!?
The Great General of Darkness will take your head!
Humans, the surface belongs to us, the Mykene Empire!
I will fight! Until the day the Mykene Empire reclaims the sun!!
No more mercy! Die!!
Tetsuya Tsurugi! Today we settle this!!
Tetsuya Tsurugi! I'm the one who'll send you to hell!!
Koji Kabuto! You die here!!
Koji Kabuto! This will be your grave!
Getter Robo, I'll tear you to pieces!!
I'll show you hell too, Getter Robo!!
U-uoooooh!!
I-impossiiible!!
L-long live... the Mykene Empire!!
Ngh! C-curse you, curse you!!
Uoh!? Wh-what!?
T-to think you had such power...
Ugh! I, who command seven legions, brought low here!?
N-next time, I'll show you true hell!
Th-the Great General of Darkness won't die from this!!
Curse you, Tetsuya Tsurugi...! I won't die until I take your head!
Gwuh... If I die, you die with me, Koji Kabuto!!
As expected of Getter... It did once destroy the Dinosaur Empire...!
Nngh! You'll pay for that!!
Ugh! Curse you, how insolent!
Hm! That's nothing!!
Uoh! Unforgivable!!
Fuhaha! Take this battle to the afterlife as a souvenir!!
To think a mere human could match me...!
Only now seeing the folly of defying the Great General of Darkness?
Tetsuya Tsurugi! Now the real fight begins!
Koji Kabuto! Don't think you've won!!
Don't lump me in with the Dinosaur Empire, Getter Robo!!
That won't work!
Gahahahaha! Is that all!?
Laughable! That won't defeat the Great General of Darkness!
Hmph... Mykene will never lose to the likes of you.
It seems I needn't have bothered coming out myself.
Koji Kabuto... Is that all your power amounts to?
Tetsuya Tsurugi... You'll pay for wounding me with your life!
So Getter Robo is no more than this, after all.
That won't work!
What's the matter!?
Can't hit me!
Futile!
To defy the Great General of Darkness... You fool!
If you want to die, come at me again!
You dare fight me with so little spirit!?
Any who defy me, the Great General of Darkness, shall die...
Such a feeble attack!!
Do not underestimate my power!!
Nnngh! How galling!
What!? The Great General of Darkness, helpless!?
How could I... be unable to do anything?
Ugh! How vexing!
Curse you... Such petty tricks!
Face the Great General of Darkness in a fair fight!!
The Great General of Darkness will deal the final blow!
Fall back! I'll deal with this one!!
